01About

I am a phD student in the School of Mathematics at East China University of Science and Technology.

My research explores spectral and geometric questions on graphs, including eigenvalue problems and discrete curvature. I also work on PDEs on graphs.

02Research Interests

Spectral graph theory

Spectral theory on graphs

Discrete curvature

Lin–Lu–Yau and Bakry–Émery curvature; discrete Ricci flow

PDEs on graphs

Discrete PDEs on graphs
